_comment: Seed trigger rules using the frontend's fixed tag list. Drafted from the text of NREO s.11A(1)(a)-(j), s.11A(3), s.11A(6) and Land Code s.5. A legal officer should confirm them; in the demo they are approved by reviewer 'seed'. land_acquisition and procurement intentionally have no rule yet.

triggers.note: s.11A(1)(h): landfill or land used for storage, disposal, treatment, recycling of municipal waste; (i): sewage and waste water treatment plants. s.11A(3): no preparatory work before the Board approves the report. s.11A(6): offence.
s.11A(1)(b): clearing forest for agricultural estates/plantation; (d): clearance of vegetation that may affect water supply sources.
s.11A(1)(c): logging in forest areas previously logged or with closed coupes.
s.11A(1)(d): sources of water supply for human consumption; (g): pollution of inland waters, erosion of river banks or foreshores.

s.11A(1)(e): commercial, industrial and housing estates above the area in the Prescribed Activities Order (not indexed); (j): other activities with adverse environmental impact. Applies only if the works change land use or affect the environment.
Roads are not listed by name in s.11A(1); check (f) rock extraction, (g) erosion/pollution and (j). Thresholds are in the Prescribed Activities Order (not indexed).
Land Code s.5: native customary rights. Check NCR status with the Land and Survey Department before works. Legal officer to confirm this is the best section to cite.
